verdict.rationale: Calendly's docs say users can 'Connect multiple calendars' (calendly-docs-15, calendly-docs-42) and that Calendly syncs them to 'check for conflicts before someone books time' (calendly-docs-49). A community user independently calls checking multiple calendars for open blocks Calendly's 'killer feature' (calendly-comm-10-refresh-65cae820cb83c78d). One user reports that shown availability is often inaccurate (calendly-comm-19), which slightly weakens the double-booking guarantee. missing for 10: explicit evidence naming support for Google, Outlook and Apple (iCloud) calendars specifically, and documentation of how conflict checking works across all connected calendars.
